about: Suggest an improvement to application controls, output or workflows
title: '[Feature - Application] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

> **This repository is public.** Use synthetic examples. Keep real document contents,
> personal information, credentials, private keys, CUI and classified information
> out of text, attachments and logs. Check URLs before posting.
>
> Report vulnerabilities through [private security reporting](https://github.com/marinecoders/dondocs/security/advisories/new).
> Keep exploit details private and follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/marinecoders/dondocs/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

## Problem or workflow

Describe the task, who needs it and where the current workflow falls short.

## Proposed behavior

Explain what should happen and which part of the app or companion it affects.

## Alternatives

Describe any existing control or workaround you tried, if applicable.

## Supporting details

Include synthetic mockups or examples if useful. If a service requirement drives
the request, cite the governing publication, edition and paragraph or page.
Link only to publicly releasable sources.

Discuss major workflow changes and dependency additions with maintainers before
implementation. Follow [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/marinecoders/dondocs/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) for contribution approval
and submission requirements.
